findings.status: confirmed; correction recommended, not implemented by reviewer
findings.case: action scan(at: Instant) -> Unit {} plus run: scan(clock.now) meets the new job signature condition but independently receives TYPE_PRIMITIVE_SIGNATURE. Conversely action scan(at: JobRunAt) -> Unit with a named Instant-backed type satisfies ordinary callable signature checking but the staged job branch rejects it. Therefore the current clean positive job fixture has no valid authored action under the combined rules.
findings.repair: Change only the scheduled-job signature/argument plan and its owning fixtures to explicit nominal construction. Do not exempt job actions from check_callable or weaken the primitive check. Preserve the failed-check evidence rather than treating the positive fixture as clean.

recommendedMinimalRecipe.exampleLimit: The empty action illustrates a legal signature only; it does not implement reminders. JobRunAt is an ordinary authored semantic type, not a new reserved prelude type or identity capability.
recommendedMinimalRecipe.firstSliceTypeRule: Resolve exactly one nonnullable named semantic parameter whose resolved parent is nonnullable Instant, with no added constraints for this minimal slice; exact Unit result and statically resolved Action remain required. Check semantic identity, not the spelling JobRunAt or representation equality. This direct, unconstrained wrapper is a bounded implementation option, not a universal restriction on future jobs.
recommendedMinimalRecipe.firstSliceArgumentRule: Exactly one positional argument: a statically resolved semantic constructor of the same nominal declaration as the parameter, containing exactly one positional exact compiler-owned clock.now. No named arguments, arbitrary expressions, nested arbitrary calls, sibling wrappers, nullable parents/parameters, Text/CalendarDate/Duration wrappers, authored timestamps or implicit conversion. Install the dedicated job clock environment and invoke ordinary constructor and callable compatibility checking, not just an AST spelling comparison.
recommendedMinimalRecipe.astParser: Keep Declaration::Job and the existing InvocationExpression/Expression::Invocation representation. parse_job_declaration already parses an invocation whose argument can be an invocation; no new host API, callable family or generic event grammar is needed. Preserve exactly one concurrency/run/retry clause and the existing fixed interval rules.
recommendedMinimalRecipe.staticEvidence: Retain the job-to-action call edge and compiler-derived transitive effects/failures. Resolve and check the constructor type reference and visit its inner clock read. Do not copy only the action failure set and assume the job binding adds nothing: record constructor validation or a checked proof that trusted Instant plus an unconstrained direct Instant wrapper adds no reachable domain validation rejection. Keep validation explicit; no unproved cast, swallowed failure, none result or invented durable failure disposition. Constrained wrappers are not needed to repair this first slice and remain unsupported here unless their failure handling is separately planned.
recommendedMinimalRecipe.target: Build remains JADPO_TARGET_JOB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED until a reviewed finite execution profile and checked worker lowering exist. Existing ordinary nominal construction renders validate_Name and validates the parent; that is compatibility evidence, not approval of scheduled-job target lowering.

contractAssessment.explicitNominalConstruction: Supported by type-system sections 2.2, 3.5 and 4.3, existing type EventTime = Instant {} positive source, constructor_input_compatible's declared-parent path, and existing nominal validator generation. Unit is explicitly excluded from primitive-signature rejection.
contractAssessment.specStatusPrecision: Section 7 labels the signature rule provisional/strongly recommended, but the existing compiler enforces it. The inspected section does not literally contain a golden-sketch migration sentence; TIME sketches use raw Instant. That pressure spelling is not an exception to the implemented callable ban or section 3.5.
contractAssessment.ownerChoice: No new owner public semantic choice is needed for the explicit nominal repair: it composes an existing authored type and validated-constructor contract without changing scheduler authority, budgets, business identity, policy, payload identity or delivery semantics. Owning writer should explicitly correct the saved short plan and successor fixtures; this report does not edit them or refreeze a contract.
contractAssessment.rejectedAlternative: Keeping bare run: send_due_reminders(clock.now) while passing a named semantic input via intrinsic implicit mapping would introduce a new application-interface conversion exception contrary to section 3.5. It is not approved here. A desire to retain that spelling would require a separately reviewed explicit semantic exception, not a hidden checker bypass.
contractAssessment.pressurePreservation: The exact original bare-clock pressure source cannot simultaneously be preserved as the positive executable fixture and satisfy the current primitive ban. Preserve historical/frozen pressure bytes; use a distinctly recorded migrated fixture with JobRunAt(clock.now).
contractAssessment.identityAndAuthority: JobRunAt carries the scan's time value, not an intent ID, schedule revision, ordering key, payload version, fence or principal. Compiler-owned scan activation and per-Todo durable source/revision remain separate. No RM309 event/subscriber activation, new arbitrary service identity, policy bypass or public host methods.
